title_zh: 朔州要闻：市委常委会召开会议，部署“十五五”重点交通项目谋划等工作
title_en: Shuozhou News Roundup: City Party Committee Standing Committee Meets, Deploys Transport Projects for 15th Five-Year Plan
summary_zh: 2026年11月下旬，朔州市委常委会、市政府常务会议等相继召开，部署“十五五”重点交通项目谋划、安全生产督导和优化营商环境等工作。
summary_en: In late November 2026, Shuozhou held a series of meetings, including the city Party committee standing committee and the municipal government executive meeting, to plan key transport projects for the 15th Five-Year Plan, safety supervision and business environment improvements.
